stem:
Aisha sketches the Sun's path from morning assembly to the end of the school day. On her sketch the Sun starts low in the east, climbs, then sinks toward the west.

Why does the Sun appear to move from east to west?

options.text: Earth rotates from west to east on its own axis.
Earth revolves around the Sun once each year.
Earth rotates from east to west on its own axis.
Earth's rotation explains only the Moon's path, not the Sun's.

teacher.key_rationale: Earth's west-to-east rotation makes the Sun appear to travel east to west each day.
